title: Stepping Up Public Education Efforts in Light of Residential Unit Fires in 2025 and Review of Singapore’s Building, Fire and Construction Safety Codes
what_it_is: Stepping Up Public Education Efforts in Light of Residential Unit Fires in 2025 and Review of Singapore’s Building, Fire and Construction Safety Codes

sections.label: Residential building fires in 2025
sections.summary: In 2025, there were 1,051 residential building fires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: In 2025, there were 1,051 residential building fires.

sections.label: Fire percentage of dwelling stock
sections.summary: The percentage of fires against total dwelling stock decreased from 0.067% in 2021 to 0.065% in 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The percentage of fires vis-à-vis our total dwelling stock has actually decreased, from 0.067% in 2021 to 0.065% in 2025.

sections.label: Reviewing Hong Kong fire investigations
sections.summary: The Government is reviewing early observations from Hong Kong's ongoing investigations and studying whether regulations for construction and maintenance works need strengthening.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The Government has started reviewing the early observations from Hong Kong’s ongoing investigations and is studying whether we need to strengthen the relevant regulations for works during the construction and maintenance of residential buildings.

sections.label: Refuge floors in high-rise buildings
sections.summary: High-rise residential buildings exceeding 40 storeys require at least one refuge floor per 20 storeys.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: In addition, high-rise residential buildings that exceed 40 storeys in height require at least one refuge floor per 20 storeys.

sections.label: Serious fatal fires in Singapore
sections.summary: Despite measures, three serious fires caused deaths last year, including a Toa Payoh case where fire spread from the 10th to 11th floor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
sentences.text: The lines of defence that Minister of State mentioned are, indeed assuring, including the good work by our SCDF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
sentences.text: However, in spite of all the different measures, there were three serious fires that resulted in death in Singapore last year; one particular case in Toa Payoh, where the fire spread from the 10th floor to the 11th floor, where then some residents above had some difficulties evacuating.

sections.label: SCDF public education programmes
sections.summary: SCDF runs Responder Plus Programmes across constituencies, alongside campaigns, to educate residents on using fire extinguishers and AEDs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Beyond what I mentioned earlier – Community Resilience Days, "Be-Device-Safe" campaigns, the "Better Awareness, Safer Homes" campaigns – we have various Responder Plus Programmes that the SCDF does across the country in the various constituencies, to work with and educate our residents in terms of how they can play their part in their homes, how to use fire extinguishers, AEDs, for example.

sections.label: Main cause of fires
sections.summary: Statistics show that unattended cooking is the main primary cause of fires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Statistics show that the main primary cause of fires is actually unattended cooking.

sections.label: Inspection regime during works
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Minister of State can reassure the public that the current inspection enforcement regime during construction and renovation works is sufficiently robust.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Could the Minister of State reassure the public the current inspection enforcement regime during construction and renovation works is assessed to be sufficiently robust, given that these time periods where the confluence of hot works, temporary wiring and flammable materials significantly heighten risk, as we saw in in the tragic example in Tai Po?

sections.label: Safety requirements for works
sections.summary: Construction and maintenance works in Singapore must adhere to safety requirements in the Fire Code and Workplace Safety and Health Regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Any construction and maintenance works done in Singapore must adhere to the safety requirements set out in the Fire Code, and the Workplace Safety and Health Regulations.

sections.label: Bamboo scaffolding not allowed
sections.summary: The use of bamboo as scaffolding is not allowed in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The use of bamboo as scaffolding is not allowed in Singapore.

sections.label: Community Resilience Days take-up
sections.summary: The speaker says take-up of programmes matters and SCDF conducts about 16 Community Resilience Days yearly with People's Association and Government agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I think what is most important is that beyond just having those programmes in place, there is significant take-up which shows constituencies, residents and grassroots leaders take these programmes seriously and participate fully.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I am glad to share with the House that SCDF conducts about 16 Community Resilience Days every year, working closely with People's Association and with the support of various Government agencies.

sections.label: SCDF response time and fire lifts
sections.summary: SCDF responds to most fire and rescue incidents within eight minutes, and the Fire Code requires fire lifts in high-rise structures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: First, in terms of the response time for SCDF, the SCDF is able to respond to most fire and rescue incidents within eight minutes, and this includes fire incidents in high-rise buildings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: In accordance with the Fire Code, all high-rise structures above 24 metres, or about eight storeys, are required to have fire lifts which can be switched to manual operations to facilitate the SCDF's firefighting operations for prompt access to the higher floors, and additional fire lifts are required for high-rise residential buildings 40 storeys and above.

sections.label: HFADs for seniors' homes
sections.summary: HFADs are encouraged in seniors' homes and subsidised under the Enhancement for Active Seniors Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We have encouraged HFADs to be installed in the homes of our seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: This is subsidised under the Enhancement for Active Seniors Programme.
